caption: The drawing depicts a single, intricately designed glass object, centrally positioned on a plain, light-colored background. The object appears to be a decorative vase or a pedestal with a narrow base and a wider upper section. The base is faceted with multiple flat surfaces, resembling an octagonal or polygonal shape, and appears solid and stable. Above the base, the stem is short and features a series of curved, swirling patterns. The body of the vessel is bulbous and ornate, decorated with large, circular, bubble-like reliefs arranged in tiers. The material is rendered with fine, detailed pencil shading, which gives the appearance of transparency and reflects the glassy texture of the object. The drawing is monochromatic, utilizing shades of grey to convey depth, reflections, and the three-dimensional form of the glass. There is a small, faint signature or inscription at the bottom left corner of the paper. No additional objects or details are present in the composition.
title: Lamp
